triples.relationship: shared loss through division of the people's land
triples.rationale: Micah's lament says the people's portion was measured and their fields divided. Joel announces judgment over the nations concerning Israel's scattering and the division of the Lord's land. Both describe dispossession through division of the land.
triples.source_text: On that day a parable will be taken up against you, and a lament will be sung in melody, saying: ‘We have suffered grievous misery! The portion of My people was measured with a cord, and there was no one to prevent him from turning away; our fields were divided.’

target_units.text: I will gather all the nations and bring them down to the Valley of Jehoshaphat. There I will enter into judgment with them over My people and My inheritance Israel, who were scattered among the nations; and they divided up My land
